text_en: It was two days before the Passover and the festival of Unleavened Bread. The chief priests and the scribes were looking for a way to arrest Jesus by stealth and kill him;
text_cn: 两天后就是逾越节和无酵节，司祭长和经师设法要怎样用诡计捉拿耶稣，而把他杀害，

text_en: for they said, “Not during the festival, or there may be a riot among the people. ”
text_cn: 因为他们说：“不要在庆节内，怕民间发生暴动。”

text_en: While he was at Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very costly ointment of nard, and she broke open the jar and poured the ointment on his head.
text_cn: 当耶稣在伯达尼癞病人西满家里，正坐席的时候，来了一个女人，拿着一玉瓶珍贵的纯‘纳尔多’香液。她打破玉瓶，就倒在耶稣头上。

text_en: But some were there who said to one another in anger, “Why was the ointment wasted in this way?
text_cn: 有些人颇不满意，就彼此说：“为什么要这样浪费香液？

text_en: For this ointment could have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and the money given to the poor. ” And they scolded her.
text_cn: 这香液原可以卖三百多块银钱，施舍给穷人！”他们对那女人很生气。

text_en: But Jesus said, “Let her alone; why do you trouble her? She has performed a good service for me.
text_cn: 耶稣却说：“由她罢！你们为什么叫她难受？她在我身上作了一件善事，

text_en: For you always have the poor with you, and you can show kindness to them whenever you wish; but you will not always have me.
text_cn: 因为你们常有穷人同你们在一起，你们几时愿意，就能给他们行善；但是我，你们却不常有。

text_en: She has done what she could; she has anointed my body beforehand for its burial.
text_cn: 她已做了她能做的：提前傅抹了我的身体，是为安葬之事。

text_en: Truly I tell you, wherever the good news is proclaimed in the whole world, what she has done will be told in remembrance of her. ”
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：将来福音无论传到全世界什么地方，必要述说她所作的事，来记念她。”

text_en: Then Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went to the chief priests in order to betray him to them.
text_cn: 于是，那十二人中之一，犹达斯依斯加略，去见司祭长，要把耶稣交与他们。

text_en: When they heard it, they were greatly pleased, and promised to give him money. So he began to look for an opportunity to betray him.
text_cn: 他们听了以后，不胜欣喜，许下给他银钱；他就找寻良机，将耶稣交出。

text_en: On the first day of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb is sacrificed, his disciples said to him, “Where do you want us to go and make the preparations for you to eat the Passover? ”
text_cn: 无酵（jiào）节的第一天，即宰杀逾越节羔羊的那一天，门徒对耶稣说：“你愿意我们往哪里去，给你预备吃逾越节晚餐？”

text_en: So he sent two of his disciples, saying to them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you; follow him,
text_cn: 耶稣就打发两个门徒，对他们说：“你们往城里去，必有一个拿着水罐的人迎面而来，你们就跟着他去；

text_en: and wherever he enters, say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks, Where is my guest room where I may eat the Passover with my disciples? ’
text_cn: 他无论进入哪里，你们就对那家主说：师傅问：我同我的门徒吃逾越节晚餐的客厅在哪里？

text_en: He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there. ”
text_cn: 他必指给你们一间铺设好了的宽大楼厅，你们就在那里为我们预备罢！”

text_en: So the disciples set out and went to the city, and found everything as he had told them; and they prepared the Passover meal.
text_cn: 门徒去了，来到城里，所遇见的，正如耶稣给他们所说的；他们就预备了逾越节晚餐。

text_en: When it was evening, he came with the twelve.
text_cn: 到了晚上，耶稣同那十二人来了。

text_en: And when they had taken their places and were eating, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me, one who is eating with me. ”
text_cn: 他们坐席吃饭时，耶稣说：“我实在告诉你们：你们中有一个与我同食的要负卖我。”

text_en: They began to be distressed and to say to him one after another, “Surely, not I? ”
text_cn: 他们就都忧闷起来，一个一个的问他说：“难道是我吗？”

text_en: He said to them, “It is one of the twelve, one who is dipping bread into the bowl with me.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“是十二人中的一个，同我一起在盘子里蘸的那一个。

text_en: For the Son of Man goes as it is written of him, but woe to that one by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would have been better for that one not to have been born. ”
text_cn: 人子固然要按照指着他所记载的而去，但是负卖人子的那人是有祸的！那人若没有生，为他更好。”

text_en: While they were eating, he took a loaf of bread, and after blessing it he broke it, gave it to them, and said, “Take; this is my body. ”
text_cn: 他们正吃的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝福了，掰开，递给他们说：“你们拿去吃罢！这是我的身体。”

text_en: Then he took a cup, and after giving thanks he gave it to them, and all of them drank from it.
text_cn: 又拿起杯来，祝谢了，递给他们，他们都从杯中喝了。

text_en: He said to them, “This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“这是我的血，新约的血，为大众流出来的。

text_en: Truly I tell you, I will never again drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：我决不再喝这葡萄汁了，直到我在天主的国里喝新酒的那天。”

text_en: When they had sung the hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
text_cn: 他们唱完圣咏，就出来，往橄榄山去了。

text_en: And Jesus said to them, “You will all become deserters; for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered. ’
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们都要跌倒，因为有记载说：‘我要打击牧人，羊群就要四散。’

text_en: But after I am raised up, I will go before you to Galilee. ”
text_cn: 但我复活后，要在你们以先，到加里肋亚去。”

text_en: Peter said to him, “Even though all become deserters, I will not. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄对他说：“即便众人都要跌倒，我却不然。”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, this day, this very night, before the cock crows twice, you will deny me three times. ”
text_cn: 耶稣就向他说：“我实在告诉你：就在今天，这一夜里，鸡叫两遍以前，你要三次不认我。”

text_en: But he said vehemently, “Even though I must die with you, I will not deny you. ” And all of them said the same.
text_cn: 伯多禄更加激烈地说：“即便我该同你一起死，我也决不会不认你。”众人也都这样说了。

text_en: They went to a place called Gethsemane; and he said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray. ”
text_cn: 他们来到一个名叫革责玛尼的庄园里；耶稣对门徒说：“你们坐在这里，等我去祈祷。”

text_en: He took with him Peter and James and John, and began to be distressed and agitated.
text_cn: 遂带着伯多禄、雅各伯和若望与他同去；他开始惊惧恐怖，

text_en: And he said to them, “I am deeply grieved, even to death; remain here, and keep awake. ”
text_cn: 便对他们说：“我的心灵悲伤得要死；你们留在这里，且要醒寤。”

text_en: And going a little farther, he threw himself on the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
text_cn: 耶稣往前走了不远，俯伏在地祈求，如果可能，使这时辰离他而去，

text_en: He said, “Abba, Father, for you all things are possible; remove this cup from me; yet, not what I want, but what you want. ”
text_cn: 说：“阿爸！父啊！一切为你都可能：请给我免去这杯罢！但是，不要照我所愿意的，而要照你所愿意的。”

text_en: He came and found them sleeping; and he said to Peter, “Simon, are you asleep? Could you not keep awake one hour?
text_cn: 耶稣回来，见他们睡着了，就对伯多禄说：“西满！你睡觉吗？你不能醒寤一个时辰吗？

text_en: Keep awake and pray that you may not come into the time of trial; the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. ”
text_cn: 你们醒寤祈祷罢！免陷于诱惑。心神固然切愿，但肉体却软弱。”

text_en: And again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
text_cn: 耶稣又去祈祷，说了同样的话。

text_en: And once more he came and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they did not know what to say to him.
text_cn: 他又回来，见他们仍是睡着，因为他们的眼睛沉重，也不知道要回答他什么。

text_en: He came a third time and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and taking your rest? Enough! The hour has come; the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
text_cn: 他第三次回来，对他们说：“你们还睡下去吗？还安息吗？够了！时辰到了，看，人子就要被交付在罪人手中了。

text_en: Get up, let us be going. See, my betrayer is at hand. ”
text_cn: 起来！我们去罢！看，那负卖我的来近了。”

text_en: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, arrived; and with him there was a crowd with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
text_cn: 耶稣还说话的时候，那十二人中之一的犹达斯，遂即到了，同他一起的，还有带着刀剑棍棒的群众，是由司祭长、经师和长老那里派来的。

text_en: Now the betrayer had given them a sign, saying, “The one I will kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard. ”
text_cn: 那出卖耶稣的人曾给他们一个暗号说：“我口亲谁，谁就是；你们拿住他，小心带去。”

text_en: So when he came, he went up to him at once and said, “Rabbi! ” and kissed him.
text_cn: 犹达斯一来，便立刻到耶稣跟前说：“辣彼！”遂口亲了他。

text_en: Then they laid hands on him and arrested him.
text_cn: 他们就向耶稣下手，拿住了他。

text_en: But one of those who stood near drew his sword and struck the slave of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
text_cn: 站在旁边的人中，有一个拔出剑来，砍了大司祭的仆人一剑，削下了他的一个耳朵。

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest me as though I were a bandit?
text_cn: 耶稣开口对他们说：“你们带着刀剑棍棒出来拿我，如同对付强盗一样；

text_en: Day after day I was with you in the temple teaching, and you did not arrest me. But let the scriptures be fulfilled. ”
text_cn: 我天天在你们当中，在圣殿里施教，你们没有拿我；但这是为应验经上的话。”

text_en: All of them deserted him and fled.
text_cn: 门徒都撇下他逃跑了。

text_en: A certain young man was following him, wearing nothing but a linen cloth. They caught hold of him,
text_cn: 那时，有一个少年人，赤身披着一块麻布，跟随耶稣，人们也抓住了他；

text_en: but he left the linen cloth and ran off naked.
text_cn: 但他撇下麻布，赤着身子逃走了。

text_en: They took Jesus to the high priest; and all the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes were assembled.
text_cn: 他们把耶稣带到大司祭那里，所有的司祭长、长老和经师也都聚集在那里。

text_en: Peter had followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest; and he was sitting with the guards, warming himself at the fire.
text_cn: 伯多禄远远的跟着耶稣，直到大司祭的庭院里面，同差役们坐在一起，烤火取暖。

text_en: Now the chief priests and the whole council were looking for testimony against Jesus to put him to death; but they found none.
text_cn: 司祭长和全体公议会，寻找证据反对耶稣，为把他处死，却没有找着。

text_en: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony did not agree.
text_cn: 原来有许多人造假证据告他，但那些证据各不相符。

text_en: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
text_cn: 有几个人站起来，作假见证告他说：

text_en: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another, not made with hands. ’”
text_cn: “我们曾听他说过：我要拆毁这座用手建造的圣殿，三天内要另建一座不用手建造的。”

text_en: But even on this point their testimony did not agree.
text_cn: 连他们的这证据也不相符合。

text_en: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it that they testify against you? ”
text_cn: 于是，大司祭起来，站在中间，问耶稣说：“这些人作证反对你的事，你什么也不回答吗？”

text_en: But he was silent and did not answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One? ”
text_cn: 耶稣却不作声，什么也不回答。大司祭又问他说：“你是默西亚，那应受赞颂者的儿子吗？”

text_en: Jesus said, “I am; and ‘you will see the Son of Man seated at the right hand of the Power, ’ and ‘coming with the clouds of heaven. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“我是，并且你们要看见人子，坐在大能者的右边，乘着天上的云彩降来。”

text_en: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “Why do we still need witnesses?
text_cn: 大司祭遂撕裂自己的衣服说： “何必还需要见证呢？

text_en: You have heard his blasphemy! What is your decision? ” All of them condemned him as deserving death.
text_cn: 你们都听见亵渎的话了，你们看着该怎样？”众人都判定他该死。

text_en: Some began to spit on him, to blindfold him, and to strike him, saying to him, “Prophesy! ” The guards also took him over and beat him.
text_cn: 有些人就开始向他吐唾沫，蒙起他的脸来，用拳头打他，对他说：“你作先知罢！”差役且用巴掌打他。

text_en: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant-girls of the high priest came by.
text_cn: 伯多禄在下边庭院里时，来了一个大司祭的使女，

text_en: When she saw Peter warming himself, she stared at him and said, “You also were with Jesus, the man from Nazareth. ”
text_cn: 看见伯多禄烤火，就注视他说：“你也是和那个纳匝肋人耶稣一起的。”

text_en: But he denied it, saying, “I do not know or understand what you are talking about. ” And he went out into the forecourt. Then the cock crowed.
text_cn: 伯多禄却否认说：“我不知道，也不明白你说什么。”他遂走出去，到了门廊，鸡就叫了。

text_en: And the servant-girl, on seeing him, began again to say to the bystanders, “This man is one of them. ”
text_cn: 那使女看见他，就又给站在旁边的人说：“这也是他们中间的人。”

text_en: But again he denied it. Then after a little while the bystanders again said to Peter, “Certainly you are one of them; for you are a Galilean. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄又否认了。过了一会儿，站在旁边的人又再对伯多禄说：“你确是他们中间的，因为你也是个加里肋亚人。”

text_en: But he began to curse, and he swore an oath, “I do not know this man you are talking about. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄就开始诅咒，并发誓说：“我不认得你们说的这个人。”

text_en: At that moment the cock crowed for the second time. Then Peter remembered that Jesus had said to him, “Before the cock crows twice, you will deny me three times. ” And he broke down and wept.
text_cn: 立时鸡叫了第二遍。伯多禄遂想起耶稣给他所说的话：“鸡叫二遍以前，你要三次不认我。”就放声大哭起来。
